description: Vidu Q4 Preview (viduq4-preview): next-gen flagship for expressive audio & video; image-to-video and reference-to-video, 24fps, 540p/720p/1080p/2K/4K. Official global USD table (1 credit = $0.005): 540p $0.045, 720p $0.095, 1080p $0.12, 2K $0.19, 4K $0.39 per second; the credit table charges 9/19/24/38/78 credits per second for the same tiers. The model map lists 1-16s selectable while the credit table lists 3-16s billing, so the minimum billable duration is not stated consistently across the two official pages.
